subject: business-studies
title: Combining SWOT and PESTLE
welcome_lead: Use PESTLE to find external factors, then feed them into SWOT.
meta_desc: A-Level Analysis: combining SWOT and PESTLE for strategy.
final_note: PESTLE feeds the OT in SWOT; the firm's audit feeds the SW.

concepts.def: Comprehensive review of internal and external factors.
Opportunities and threats often come from PESTLE.
Strengths and weaknesses come from internal audit.
Focusing on factors that genuinely affect strategy.
Ranking issues by impact and likelihood.
Picking Ansoff or Porter direction based on the analysis.

walkthroughs.body_html: PESTLE generates the long-list of external factors; SWOT condenses them into opportunities and threats. Internal data from accounts, HR and operations fills S and W.
The classic SO/WO/ST/WT matrix turns analysis into options - exploit strengths against opportunities, defend weaknesses from threats.
End with a clear recommendation - extend product range, diversify market, exit a segment. Analysis without decision is a school exercise, not management.
